methodology.identity: Historical roster IDs are mapped to stable owner IDs using owner-tendencies rosters_by_season, so team-name changes do not split a franchise.
methodology.completed_games: Only games explicitly marked is_completed=true with two numeric team scores are included. Future placeholders are excluded.
methodology.all_play: Each team is compared with every other team score from the same completed regular-season week.
methodology.expected_wins: Weekly expected wins equal (all-play wins + 0.5 × all-play ties) divided by the number of possible opponents.
methodology.luck: Luck wins equal actual win-equivalents minus expected wins. Positive is fortunate; negative is unfortunate.
methodology.schedule_strength: Average points scored by a team's actual regular-season opponents; rank 1 is the toughest schedule.
methodology.rivalry_score: Up to 40 points for meetings, 25 for series balance, 25 for close average margins, and 10 for postseason meetings.
methodology.archetypes: Deterministic percentile scores combine transactions, trades, waivers/free agency, draft-pick flow, roster age, and current power ranking. Labels are descriptive, not value judgments.

methodology.actual_win_equivalent: One for a win, one-half for a tie, and zero for a loss.
methodology.expected_wins: All-play win percentage converted to one expected win per week.
methodology.schedule_strength_rank: Rank 1 faced the highest average opponent score.
